resume.summary: Marketer who shoots and cuts his own work. Seven-plus years making video and social for construction, trades, and real estate brands, with the numbers behind it: a social initiative that earned more than 20x the engagement of standard content and a campaign that raised ad click-through by over 200%. Built a business on referral relationships with builders, developers, and realtors, and holds a Master's in Marketing Analytics plus an FAA Part 107 drone license.

jobs.title: Owner / Producer
bullets: Increased brand presence for construction companies by turning construction into cinema, shooting on active job sites across the Valley.
Built referral relationships with realtors, home developers, and CEOs; filmed model homes for Blandford Homes and photographed listings for agents.
Generated leads with Meta ads and tracked performance with pixel data on site; closed $10k in new business from optimizing Google Business.
Shot, edited, graded, and scored the work myself in Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Photoshop, DaVinci Resolve, and After Effects.

jobs.title: Media Specialist
bullets: Created and led a social content initiative that earned more than 20x the engagement of standard content.
Created and led a campaign that raised click-through rates for running ads by over 200%, and drove paid and organic engagement by over 100%.
Refreshed photo and video across every school website and set content priorities with executives.
Built AI workflows that cut production times in half without lowering the standard.

jobs.title: Videographer
bullets: Delivered 200+ videos over two years that reached millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels.
Directed cinematography for higher-end brand shoots each quarter inside a 15-person media team.
Piloted drone and gimbal systems on location and architected the online stock footage library.

jobs.title: Photography Teacher
bullets: Grew the program's social accounts, lifting enrollment 20% the following year.
Organized a community gallery night that brought families through the door.

skills: Editing (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Audition, Final Cut Pro)

education.degree: Master's in Marketing, Marketing Analytics Specialization
